hook: If you aim sound the right way, water floats in mid-air.
title: Sound Waves Can Make Water Float
description:
Acoustic levitation uses sound waves to hold small droplets and beads in mid-air. Two opposing waves create still spots where light objects get trapped. It is real and you can see it on camera.

#Shorts #Science #Technology

scenes.narration: If you aim sound right, water floats.
scenes.headline: Water Floats

scenes.narration: Tiny droplets hang in mid-air, doing nothing.
scenes.headline: Hanging In Air

scenes.narration: Sound is pressure pushing on air.
scenes.headline: Sound Is Pressure

scenes.narration: Two opposing waves create still spots.
scenes.headline: Still Spots

scenes.narration: Small objects get trapped in those spots.
scenes.headline: Trapped In Place

scenes.narration: Sound you can't hear holds them up.
scenes.headline: Silent Lift
